title: Homesite Swap Allowances Chart — Homesite Reservation
content:
A swap moves a Homesite Reservation from one homesite to another available homesite. The allowances below are those of the premium class shown in the first column.

| Premium class | Swaps with no swap fee | Fee for each swap beyond the free swaps (USD) | Calendar days after the reservation date within which a swap may be made | Maximum swaps per reservation | Difference refunded on a swap into a class with lower required funds | Swap restarts the hold period from the swap date | Swap into another community allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Interior Homesite | 1 | 250.00 | 7 | 2 | Yes | No | Yes |
| Corner Homesite | 1 | 250.00 | 7 | 2 | Yes | No | Yes |
| Cul-de-Sac Homesite | 1 | 500.00 | 5 | 2 | Yes | No | No |
| Greenbelt Homesite | 1 | 750.00 | 5 | 1 | Yes | No | No |
| Water-View Homesite | 0 | 1000.00 | 3 | 1 | Yes | No | No |
| Golf-Frontage Homesite | 0 | 1500.00 | 3 | 1 | No | No | No |

## Distinctions

- The "difference refunded" column refers to the difference in deposit and premium holding fee on a swap into a class with lower required funds.
- A Water-View Homesite or Golf-Frontage Homesite reservation has no free swap: its only swap carries the fee in the second column.
- No class restarts the hold period on a swap.
